consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy or consulate in South Sudan. For consular assistance, contact the Australian Embassy in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The security situation and other factors mean the Australian Government's ability to provide consular services in South Sudan is extremely limited.
